caption:
The video depicts a studio-like interior with grey walls, two metal shelving racks stacked with cardboard boxes, a closed door, and two bright softbox lights flanking a white floor. A central yellow-and-white checkered lane runs toward the viewer, bordered by horizontal green bead boundary lines, while the background stays fixed.

Across this bare lane, a staggered procession of spherical-bead kart figures enters from the left and translates steadily rightward, each occluded by the frame edge as it passes. The maroon-hatted figure on a bead kart slides into view first, crosses the checkered lane, and drifts off the right edge. Behind it in time follows a green-hatted figure on a similar kart riding in a farther lane, then a green-and-white dinosaur-like rider, then a blue spiky figure, all moving left-to-right with comparable horizontal gaps. The four riders form a continuous procession moving in the same direction, the lane and lines staying stationary beneath them.

As the last blue spiky kart clears the right edge, the checkered lane returns to being empty. The studio backdrop remains entirely fixed throughout. The observed motion is purely object translation.

review_issues.quote: a single-file queue of spherical-bead kart figures enters from the left
review_issues.problem: The riders are not in a single file. Across the frames the green-hatted figure consistently travels in a farther lane (smaller and higher in the image) while the maroon-hatted, dinosaur-like and blue spiky riders occupy the nearer lane, so the procession is staggered across two depths rather than one line.

review_issues.quote: all keeping roughly constant left-to-right spacing
review_issues.problem: Because the figures ride in two different depth lanes, describing them as a single line with constant spacing misrepresents the layout; only their horizontal gaps are roughly comparable.
